summary.headline: Planetary Configurations and Their Effects
summary.text: Astrological judgments on the configurations of Mars with the Sun, Venus, and Mercury, including conjunctions, sextiles, trines, squares, and oppositions and their effects on kings, armies, women, childbirth, disease, and the land of the Romans. The Mars–Mercury conjunction is associated with roses, chemistry, hyacinth, stones, and pearls.
